title: Delinquency Surcharge on Deferrals of Past-Due Installments
content:
A deferral of a past-due installment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts bears a delinquency surcharge, a flat dollar amount added to the deferral fee. It follows the days the deferred installment is past due, counted in calendar days from the next due date on the contract record to the request date.

| Days past due on the request date | Delinquency surcharge |
|---|---|
| 16 or more | late-stage deferral surcharge: 5.00 |
| 1 to 15 | early-stage deferral surcharge: 2.50 |
| not yet past due | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, next due date 2026-03-10)

| Request date | Days past due | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-10 | 0 | none |
| 2026-03-11 | 1 | 2.50 |
| 2026-03-25 | 15 | 2.50 |
| 2026-03-26 | 16 | 5.00 |

Hypothetical: a deferral charge of 43.75 on a request 18 days past due comes to 48.75 with the surcharge.
